Palliative radiation + frunevetmab for feline bone-invasive oral SCC University of Pennsylvania · USA Active - Recruiting What is being offered: Pilot palliative study for feline bone-invasive oral SCC. Who may qualify: Confirmed cancer diagnosis required; Active tumor required; No metastasis; Mandibular or maxillary bone lysis; chemotherapy washout: 21 days; radiation washout: 21 days; Immunotherapy and anti ngf washout 21d Costs / coverage: 🟠 Partially funded. Owners pay initial staging to establish eligibility, including the initial head CT, bloodwork and diagnostic cytology/histopathology of the oral mass and lymph nodes when needed.
